basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM AI Builder · Production LLM Agents · Founder · MBA
basics.summary: Senior IC who ships AI and automation into live GTM workflows end-to-end, without PM or design hand-holding. At LumApps built production AI outbound agents that doubled open rates and approved opportunities (forecast $4M/quarter pipeline). At Beekeeper shipped a GenAI demo system pulling from Salesforce, an AI Onboarding Specialist, and replaced $337K in vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline in 6 weeks. Founder of three companies (high-agency by default), 13+ years of production software, daily user of Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI APIs, and MCP for the real operational work.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns AI transformation end-to-end for GTM. Builds production AI agents and the context layer that powers internal sales, product, and CS workflows.
highlights: Built and deployed production AI agents for outbound sales (the SDR/AE motion). 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day; forecast $4M in approved opportunities per quarter at 25% conversion.

Built AI Brain, an intelligent context layer unifying conversation data, usage analytics, and notes. Surfaces deal patterns and signals that drive priorities across product, sales, and CS. Architected with no PM hand-holding.
Owns company-wide AI transformation, governance, and sales enablement. Sets technical direction and communicates trade-offs directly to C-level.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Senior IC who shipped AI and automation into the GTM motion. Prototyped in days, shipped to production in weeks, every release instrumented for measurable impact.
highlights: Built GenAI demo system for Sales: auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. AE-facing tool; improved demo speed and close rates.

Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation contract with an in-house LLM pipeline (GitHub Actions + OpenAI APIs) shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Pattern reused across adjacent enrichment workflows.

Built AI Onboarding Specialist giving every new signup personalized, high-touch setup guidance. 100% of customers guided through onboarding without adding headcount; classic post-sale support automation play.

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Employee Referral, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week whether it moved the needle.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist and mentor for seed-to-VC stage startups. Advises on AI architecture, GTM automation, and shipping pragmatic systems that move metrics.
highlights: Mentored portfolio companies on AI strategy and GTM automation patterns: agents, enrichment pipelines, lead scoring, summarisation workflows.
Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built every layer from blank page to 500+ live deliveries with no dedicated PM or design.
highlights: Shipped end-to-end autonomous drone delivery platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL). 500+ successful deliveries, every flight instrumented. Defined scope, navigated ambiguity, owned outcomes.
Built cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch. Enterprise-grade reliability that enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: Research engineer on Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems. Foundational AI work that underpins current LLM and agentic systems craft.
highlights: Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs impractical on local hardware. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research, work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics at EPFL. Supervised 20+ master's students through hands-on projects in genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied AI.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Senior IC (IC5) building AI-powered tooling and automation across Mews' full GTM stack (Salesforce, Nue, HubSpot, Databricks, Gong) for a $300M+ ARR commercial engine. End-to-end ownership: problem definition to production. Builds Pipeline Command Center, Deal Passport, Territory Intelligence, Quote Builder, etc. Heavy use of Claude, OpenAI APIs, MCP, agent frameworks. 7+ years production software, no PM/design hand-holding, RevOps adjacency a plus. US-only role: AZ/CA/CO/FL/GA/IL/KS/MA/MT/NV/NJ/NY/NC/OH/OR/SC/TN/TX/UT/VT/VA/WA/WI. $120k-$180k + commission.
_jobApplication.notes: Very strong fit on the building/AI/IC axis. LumApps outbound agents = exact JD use case (lead scoring, agent workflows). Beekeeper GenAI demo from Salesforce, AI Onboarding, $337K LLM pipeline in 6 weeks = direct match for 'prototype days, ship weeks'. Founder mode (3 companies) = no PM/design hand-holding. Daily Claude/Claude Code/MCP user. Gaps: (1) US-only role, candidate in Zurich (hard constraint - they may not sponsor relocation). (2) No Nue/Databricks/Gong production experience. (3) Salesforce experience is via consumption (pulling data) not native Apex/Flow dev. Worth applying if there is appetite for US relocation; otherwise consider asking recruiter if Mews EU-based equivalent of this role exists (HQ is Prague).
